scope: Persistent grants in authenticated world actor actions
invariant: Each authenticated world action uses current scoped authority, and revocation cancels affected live actions without invalidating independent grants.
required_evidence: Both authorized hosts in Debug and ASan/UBSan
Full P00-P10 baseline and unchanged locked assertions
Explicit provisioning, transactional seed validation, and restart persistence
Authenticated delegation, parent attenuation, subject-filtered listing, and replay rejection
Motion and object cancellation after grant or ancestor revocation
Independent grants and credential-only revocation preserve valid authority
Real issuer revocation during ancestor-status preparation prevents pending admission
Native application observations and workspace execution remain unavailable through world grants
Independent mutations detect missing decision invalidation and object scope enforcement
limitations: Actor channels remain inherited local sockets.
Workspace grants, application visibility, and execution authority need separate integration.
Issuer snapshots are not atomic with later world effects.
Distributed revocation acknowledgement and nonempty bootstrap profiles remain pending.
Physical controls and full native session acceptance remain pending.
